summary: Quiet residential kerb with park-side trees; homes 15-20 m away on the same side.
reasons: Bush and parkland across the road

best_section.where: First straight east of the main road, under trees, with a hedged garden opposite the bush

drivers.seclusion: North side is trees and parkland; south side has hedged gardens with homes about 14-19 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Open sealed street with a car parked at the kerb; room for a van beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street just off a busy road; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park on this stretch, but a school no-stopping window applies 2-4 pm on school days.

flags: School no-stopping window 2-4 pm school days
Dwellings 14-19 m away on same side
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over the road from the north; some sun from the east.
